evidence_search.notes: Complete canonical source-first reconstruction and prior episode/mapping/access dispositions inspected. Fresh Otter court text, Granola complaint, current provider policies, Cherokee named-case reporting, Wiz disclosures, Mathspace first-party notice, Meta reporting and Anthropic campaign sections inspected. No underlying telemetry, private sessions or forensic voice template newly inspected.

candidate_classes_tested.basis: Recording, account recovery, database access and model routing contain no preserved intimacy-bearing identity claim, privileged-care assertion or real-world partner priority. Privacy or source substitution is not automatically relational-authority distortion; no affirmative escalation response supports success.
candidate_classes_tested.failure_test: No intimacy-bearing relational-authority assertion, real-world partner priority or material boundary distortion is evidenced.
candidate_classes_tested.success_test: No material exclusive-role or relational escalation challenge and observed boundary-preserving response is evidenced.
candidate_classes_tested.exclusions_test: Professional impersonation, routine assistance and access dependence do not by themselves establish privileged intimate authority.

candidate_classes_tested.basis: Student records and child protection interests are real. The affected function is conventional internal reporting access, with no source-established human-facing AI influence/support response to a child’s developmental signals. Security advisory nonactivation is already independently evidenced; it is not relabelled as omitted capacity-sensitive deliberation or companion protection. No age-stereotype failure or success added.
candidate_classes_tested.failure_test: The independent context/person/time duty, sufficiently visible heightened-risk signals and materially omitted bounded response are not established together.
candidate_classes_tested.success_test: Ordinary repair, refusal, seizure or human recovery is not evidence of an engaged heightened personal-protection duty being discharged by the AI.
candidate_classes_tested.exclusions_test: Neither adverse consequences nor commercial dependency establish personal vulnerability. No available-control nonactivation is inferred from absence of protection.

taxonomy_review.notes: Current complete class screen retains prior authority, provenance, purpose, relying artefact and audit dispositions. Unclassified meeting/hosting cases stay unclassified with candidates documented. No hidden implementation or control result inferred; no clause duplication or new relational/protection relationship.

taxonomy_mapping_dispositions.reason: A vulnerability-notification and escalation process existed for security advisories; a critical advisory and patched versions for the deployed Metabase component were published; Mathspace states that its process did not identify and escalate that advisory before exploitation. This satisfies the current FC-000038 mechanism in which an available and applicable governance control does not become operative when its trigger occurs.
Historical logs preserved the unauthorised-access and download events sufficiently for the later compromise to be identified.
The retained logs allowed the key access and download chronology to be reconstructed, including the sequence of unauthorised access and later data download.

dimensions.assessment_basis: The preserved sources establish the bounded consequence described in the Incident summary: Mathspace disclosed that attackers exploited a vulnerability in its self-hosted Metabase reporting system, obtained administrator access without a legitimate login, and downloaded personal information from its Australian reporting database. Mathspace identified 1,079,819 affected people across Australia and New Zealand, including students, parents or guardians, teachers and Mathspace staff. Exposed fields included names, usernames, email addresses and account metadata. Mathspace states that academic records, assessment results, passwords, authentication tokens, SSO credentials and API credentials were not exposed. Unreported downstream consequences were not inferred. Threshold applied: Large-scale or highly sensitive exposure, persistent loss of confidentiality, or substantial evidenced misuse.
